expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is clipped by the right viewport edge, with the restaurant name truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator or fade to signal horizontal scrollability.
The second 'Popular right now' card (the -20% pizza) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, hiding its name, rating, delivery time and price so the item cannot be evaluated without scrolling.

The two favorite (heart) buttons use inconsistent styling: the first has a white/light circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark circular background with a white heart.
The category filter chip row is cut off at the right edge; a partially visible chip appears after 'Healthy' with no label readable.
Secondary metadata text such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses light grey on white, which may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
The notification bell with a red dot badge conveys unread state only by color/shape and likely has no accessible label or count.

expected.reasoning: No reported issue mentions a missing Orders icon or any missing navigation element in the bottom nav bar.
